name: @emsenn/web-topology
description: The categorical home of the web tier: nodes bearing client/server roles, exchanges as labeled generating morphisms, relays as their free composites (composition factors through peers by theorem), and the traversal boundary onto charged traces.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run audit:boundary
